mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% and increasing by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 4.5%) signals persistent inflation and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to historical norms indicates a late-cycle expansion, which is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) signals strong economic growth and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls > 5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), rising inflation signals the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods in the high-inflation regime, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
